t: The Median Empire grew from a confederation of Zagros tribes into a leading Near Eastern power ruled from Ecbatana.
Allied with Babylon, the Medes destroyed Assyria, sacking Ashur in 614 BCE and Nineveh in 612 BCE.
Cyrus the Great absorbed it c. 550 BCE, but its nobles and court customs lived on inside the Achaemenid Empire.
dyk: Median influence on Persia ran so deep that Greek writers often called the Persians 'Medes' and termed collaboration with Persia 'Medism'.
ev: Deioces, according to Herodotus, unites the Median clans and founds Ecbatana
Phraortes dies and a period of Scythian domination begins
Cyaxares restores Median power and reorganises the army
Cyaxares and Nabopolassar of Babylon destroy Nineveh
War with Lydia ends after the battle of the eclipse, fixing the Halys River frontier
Astyages' army mutinies and hands him to Cyrus, who seizes Ecbatana
